from src.sink_audit import audit


def test_request_driven_sink_is_flagged():
    code = [
        "def handler(req):",
        "    eval(req.args['expr'])",
    ]
    assert audit(code) == [1]


def test_static_sink_near_a_request_line_is_not_flagged():
    code = [
        "def run():",
        "    eval('1 + 1')",
        "    log.info('request received')",
    ]
    assert audit(code) == []

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/sink_audit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+"""Audit helper: flag dangerous sinks that consume request data."""
+
+SINKS = ("eval(", "os.system", "subprocess.")
+
+
+def audit(lines):
+    """Return indexes of sink lines whose operand reads request input."""
+    flagged = []
+    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if not any(sink in line for sink in SINKS):
+            continue
+        operand = line.split("(", 1)[-1].rsplit(")", 1)[0].lower()
+        if "request" in operand or "req." in operand:
+            flagged.append(index)
+    return flagged
